title: Reorganizing with three tenors and baritone; Capitol and MGM
summary: He rebuilt the band with Al Cohn and Zoot; they recorded for Capitol ('Music for Dancing') and then MGM.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Yeah. Then I went back to New York and started to reorganize again. I think I took a rest for a little bit, but it was shortly after. And then that would be the band where we started with the three tenors and baritone exclusively.
And so Hal Cohen was there and Zoot.
So you're still on Columbia then, for a while.
We were on Capitol with all that.
"Music for Dancing" and all that stuff.
Then after Capitol we went with MGM for a short time.
